subject.title: feat(hooks): add waitForResult mode to POST /hooks/agent endpoint

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's `POST /hooks/agent` `waitForResult` mode as a hook-token readback surface, and what redaction, result-size, timeout/concurrency, idempotency, and error-disclosure contract must it use before merge?
rationale: The source gap and candidate implementation are clear, but this adds public gateway HTTP behavior and returns agent output/errors over hook auth; automation cannot choose that security/API contract safely.

options.title: Adopt with hardening
options.body: Keep the `waitForResult` and `announceToMain` shape, but require the replay fix plus explicit output/error/timeout/idempotency limits before merge.

options.title: Reshape the API
options.body: Ask the contributor to use a dedicated sync endpoint or result-token fetch flow if that better preserves hook-token boundaries.

options.title: Decline core readback
options.body: Keep `/hooks/agent` async-only and continue routing result-return workflows through existing session-history or plugin-specific integrations.

recommendation.title: Adopt with hardening
recommendation.body: Keep the `waitForResult` and `announceToMain` shape, but require the replay fix plus explicit output/error/timeout/idempotency limits before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest sampled history on gateway hook contract hardening and this decision is primarily API/security direction rather than a one-line implementation fix.
